column1: # Hagi: a 3D game pad (D-pad, right stick)
# Hagi (hagi.config): the Wii pointer is the touch screen in handheld mode
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL), subsdk2 (NintendoSDK_Vulkan)
# The NPDM declares 8 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap of the pool − 64 MB. Hagi reserves a 4 GB + 2 MB address region for the GameCube memory and a region for its
# coroutine stacks, cut to 64 MB (patches.py); with the SDK-wide cuts (the 62 MB node area, regions aligned to 2 MB) both end before +4.25 GB of the alias region. The block is the 6 GB iOS allows one
# reservation: 256 MB in front + 4.25 GB alias + 256 MB stack + 1.25 GB heap region (the heap touched about 450 MB in play)
